# unraid_system_time (Data Source)

System time configuration. Requires `READ_ANY` on `VARS`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "unraid_system_time" "this" {}

output "time_zone" {
  value = data.unraid_system_time.this.time_zone
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `current_time` (String) Current server time (ISO-8601, UTC).
- `ntp_servers` (List of String) Configured NTP servers (empty strings for unused slots).
- `time_zone` (String) IANA time zone in use.
- `use_ntp` (Boolean) Whether NTP/PTP sync is enabled.
